[[The Binding of Ipos]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] [[focus]] crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. 

== Lore ==
{{Legendary unlock text|The Binding of Ipos is as mystifying as it is venomous, dripping with ancient knowledge. Any warrior brave enough to carry this tome will be gifted with millennia of sinister magics.}}

== Graphics ==
The Binding of Ipos is a demonic tome. The cover is aged leather adorned with an oval frame with purple demonic runes at the center of which is a purple eye with a yellow iris that moves around as it observes its surroundings. On each of the four corners of the book are decorative metallic demonic hands with three clawed fingers and a thumb. When drawn, the book floats in front of the user and opens to the bookmark, revealing pages with purple glowing text and diagrams.

;Aura
* The player grows a purple demonic hand with three fingers and a thumb. A purple aura connects the book with the hand.

;Draw/Stow Animation
* Purple mists swirl around you as the book floats in front of you and opens.
* An ominous audio aura and faint unintelligible whispering can be heard while the weapon is drawn.

;Footfalls
* The player leaves behind puddles of dark purple viscous liquid.

;Projectiles
* Purple spherical eyes with a yellow iris.

== Trivia ==
[[File:The Binding of Ipos griffon trick.jpg|thumb|Visual bug of still displaying the floating book while mounted.]]
* The weapon was released with [[Living World Season 4]] Episode 1, [[Daybreak]].
* [[w:Ipos|Ipos]] is one of the powerful [[w:demon|demon]] princes described in the [[w:Lesser_Key_of_Solomon#Ars_Goetia|Ars Goetia]]. Ipos is known to reveal all things, past, present, and future.
* The text on The Binding of Ipos is made of a unique alphabet.<ref>[https://www.reddit.com/r/Guildwars2/comments/7l4cbu/new_demonic_alphabet/ New demonic alphabet], Reddit.com</ref>
* Just like [[Bolt]] and [[The Shining Blade]], among various other things, this focus was designed by [[Chelsea Mills]].<ref>[https://www.reddit.com/r/Guildwars2/comments/7g5td6/new_legendary_focus_the_binding_of_ipos/dqjsny9/ Comment by Chelsea Mills], Reddit.com</ref>
* There was a bug effect when using a [[mount]] while having The Binding of Ipos drawn resulting in the floating book still being visible. This was fixed around May 2020.
* One of the titles [[Orrax]] calls itself is [[Unknown Nightmares: Experiments in the Shadows#Dialogue|"Sealer of Ipos"]] and it also quotes Ipos as lying in wait for a mortal of "equal in both power and hubris".
